title: Fugl Dam
world: Old Norway by the sea, long ago, over fourteen years of voyages. The princesses' father rules a royal farm of big log halls above a sandy beach. On a small rocky island stands the troll prince's castle; far across the sea, a dark stone castle on a rocky shore holds the troll king's great hall of gold. The little dog is fluffy and white, with floppy brown ears. The old sword has a plain iron hilt; the magic bottle is round and made of blue glass. The crown cupboard is waist-high, painted blue with red-and-white rosemaling, and holds twelve small golden crowns. The iron boat is small, dark and has no oars, with a heavy iron club inside. The eleven older princes wear matching grey-blue coats; the eleven older princesses wear long dresses in different soft colours.
palette: Changeable weather on the open northern sea in spring, from gales to calm, bright days: jade-green and pewter-grey waves with white foam, towering silver-grey clouds and clear rosy dawns. Indoors, warm lamplight and the rich glow of polished gold. Accents: Ridder Rød's scarlet, the prince's forest green and gleaming golden crowns.

cast.name: Den yngste kongssønnen
cast.description: Den yngste av tolv brødre, som holder seg våken når alle andre sover, redder prinsessene og kommer tilbake forkledd som sjømann.
cast.look: A slim, brave young prince of about eighteen with a kind, open face, a straight nose, steady green-grey eyes, a quick smile and wavy dark-brown hair falling to his shoulders. He wears a forest-green hunting jacket with brass buttons and a high collar over a white shirt, a brown leather belt, dark-grey trousers and tall brown boots, with a small gold brooch shaped like a ship pinned to his collar.
cast.portrait: Background: the deck of the Ship and a jade-green sea.

cast.name: Den yngste kongssønnen som sjømann
cast.description: Den yngste kongssønnen i forkledning, med en stor matroskofte og et rødt tørkle rundt hodet. Først later han som han er en stakkars sjømann, og så en kremmer.
cast.look: A slim young man of about eighteen disguised as a poor sailor, with a kind face, a straight nose, steady green-grey eyes and a few days' dark stubble. His wavy dark-brown hair is tucked under a red kerchief knotted around his head. He wears a huge, baggy, dark-blue knitted sailor's jacket with wooden buttons that hangs down to his knees, patched canvas trousers and scuffed, salt-stained boots.
cast.portrait: Background: the door of a tiny hut by the sea.

cast.name: Den yngste prinsessen
cast.description: Den yngste av de tolv, stille men modig, som beskytter seg selv og til slutt tør å si sannheten.
cast.look: A small, slender princess of about seventeen with a round, solemn face, a short nose, dark-blue eyes under thick, level brows and a small, determined mouth. Her honey-brown hair is braided into a crown around her head. She wears a long cream-coloured dress with gold embroidery on the bodice and hem, long fitted sleeves and a narrow gold belt, with a tiny silver brooch shaped like an anchor at her throat.
cast.portrait: Background: the small-paned windows of the Great Hall with the sea beyond.

cast.name: Fugl Dam
cast.description: En enorm, hjelpsom fugl som hjelper kongssønnen når han blir forlatt, og flyr ham trygt dit han trenger å være.
cast.look: An enormous, friendly bird as tall as a three-storey house, so big that a man reaches only to its ankle, shaped a little like a giant gull. It has a pale silver-grey back, broad silver-grey wings with black tips, a snowy-white head and breast, kind dark eyes, a big hooked golden-yellow beak and huge orange feet. From the back of its neck rises one enormous, stiff, copper-red feather, as thick as a small spruce tree.
cast.portrait: Background: the jade-green sea at sunrise.

cast.name: Ridder Rød
cast.description: Styrmannen som blir misunnelig og prøver å ta æren, men som til slutt mister makten når sannheten kommer fram.
cast.look: A tall, barrel-chested, vain knight of about forty with a big square jaw, a cleft chin, a short straight nose held high, small, cold pale-blue eyes and a proud smirk. He has short flame-red hair and a short, pointed flame-red beard. He wears a round, polished steel helmet with a stiff red crest, a long scarlet surcoat with a gold border over a shirt of shiny chainmail, a wide black belt with a big gold buckle and tall black boots.
cast.portrait: Background: the high stern of the Ship with its big wooden tiller.

cast.name: Trollkongen med tolv hoder
cast.description: En trollkonge med tolv snorkende hoder som prinsessene må klø dagen lang, helt til han blir til tåke, ett hode om gangen.
cast.look: A huge, hulking troll about three times as tall as a man, with rust-red, warty skin, a broad, sagging barrel of a body, very long arms that hang down to the floor and short bowed legs. On top of his thick neck sits a bunch of exactly twelve small heads, packed tightly together like a bunch of turnips, each with a knobbly nose, droopy ears and a wispy tuft of pale straw-coloured hair. He wears a moth-eaten dark-blue velvet cloak with a tattered fur collar.
cast.portrait: Background: his great hall full of gold, with the golden throne.

cast.name: Trollprinsen
cast.description: Et stort, rart og ganske greit troll som gir kongssønnen sverdet og flasken, og som blir konge når trollkongen er borte.
cast.look: A huge, strange troll about three times as tall as a man, shaped like a giant sack of flour, with sloping shoulders, a small head, a big soft belly, short legs and huge webbed feet like a duck's. His skin is a weathered, ruddy tan. He has a nose as long as a cucumber, small kind amber eyes, big ears like cabbage leaves and a stiff crest of dark-brown hair standing straight up like a brush. He wears a mulberry-purple velvet tunic with a wide gold belt.
cast.portrait: Background: the tall columns of the Pillar Hall.

cast.name: Trollprinsens datter
cast.description: Trollprinsens datter. Først er hun en liten hund som bjeffer på en øy, så blir hun til en prinsesse med langt, lyst hår og et tynt slør som svever rundt henne.
cast.look: A willowy young woman of about eighteen with pale, milky skin, a long, narrow face, a tiny pointed nose, big silvery-grey eyes and long, pale-blonde hair that floats and drifts around her as if she were under water. A thin, misty veil floats around her too, as if lifted by a breeze. She wears a long, flowing apricot-coloured dress with a silver belt and goes barefoot.

cast.name: Kongen
cast.description: Kongen som har tolv døtre og er så glad i dem at han vil ha dem hos seg hele tiden.
cast.look: A small, wiry, elderly king with a narrow, kind, crinkly face, a small sharp nose, twinkling blue eyes, wisps of silver hair poking out under his crown and a long silver-grey beard braided into two plaits tied with little gold rings. He wears a low, wide gold crown set with green stones, a long turquoise robe with a collar of spotted grey sealskin and silver clasps shaped like fish, and soft grey felt slippers.
cast.portrait: Background: his tall carved chair in the Great Hall.

cast.name: Den nysgjerrige konen
cast.description: Den mest nysgjerrige konen i hele landet. Hun spør og spør, og løper rett til venninnene sine med nyheten.
cast.look: A short, bustling old woman with a plump little body on thin legs, like a robin, and a long neck that she cranes forward to see everything. She has a sharp little chin, a beaky nose, big curious eyes magnified by thick, round bottle-bottom spectacles and wispy white hair scraped into a tiny topknot like an onion. She wears a faded lavender dress, an orange knitted shawl and a patched brown apron with a deep pocket.

places.name: the Ship
places.look: A big, round-bellied old wooden sailing ship, its hull painted dark blue with a broad red stripe along the side, one tall mast with a single broad, square cream-coloured sail, a high carved stern with a big wooden tiller, a low rail around the deck, coils of rope and wooden barrels on deck, and a small wooden rowing boat hanging at its side.

places.name: the Pillar Hall
places.look: A tall, echoing hall inside a castle on a small rocky island, with rows of tall, smooth pale-stone columns, warm golden light from hanging oil lamps, a polished stone floor with a round star-shaped mosaic in the middle, tall arched windows looking out to sea, and a long carved wooden bench against one wall.

places.name: the Great Hall
places.look: The great hall of the king's farm by the sea: a long, high log hall with a steep, dark-beamed roof, walls hung with red and blue woven tapestries, small-paned windows looking out over the sea, a long carved table with benches, a big stone fireplace, and at the far end, on a low platform, the king's tall carved wooden chair and a long cushioned bench.

cover.prompt: The Youngest Prince rides on the back of the Giant Bird high above a jade-green sea dotted with small rocky islands, holding on to its huge copper-red neck feather with one hand and waving with the other, his hair blowing in the wind. The bird's great wings spread wide across the picture, and the sky glows pink and gold with sunrise. Far below, tiny white waves curl around the islands.
cover.caption: Den yngste kongssønnen flyr på ryggen til Fugl Dam.
cover.alt: Den yngste kongssønnen sitter på ryggen til en kjempestor fugl og flyr høyt over havet og små øyer i soloppgangen.

illustrations.anchor: En dag mens kongen lå og snorket, gikk prinsessene ut som vanlig.
illustrations.prompt: In the Great Hall on a sunny afternoon, the King lies stretched out on the long cushioned bench, fast asleep and snoring with his mouth wide open, his crown resting on his chest. Past him, twelve princesses tiptoe in a line towards the open door, each wearing a small golden crown and holding a finger to her lips: eleven sisters in dresses of different soft colours, and last of all the Youngest Princess, looking back at him with a little smile. Outside, a sunny path leads towards distant dark mountains.
illustrations.caption: Mens kongen lå og snorket, gikk prinsessene ut som vanlig.
illustrations.alt: Kongen sover og snorker på en benk med kronen på brystet. Tolv prinsesser med små gullkroner lister seg forbi ham på tærne og ut døren.

illustrations.anchor: Men prinsene ba og ba, til kongen sa ja.
illustrations.prompt: The Ship sails out of a harbour on a bright, breezy morning, its big square sail filling with wind. Along the rail, the Youngest Prince and his eleven older brothers in matching grey-blue coats wave goodbye towards the shore. High on the stern, Ridder Rød grips the big wooden tiller with one hand and puffs out his chest, looking very pleased with himself. Seagulls wheel over the jade-green water.
illustrations.caption: Kongen ga dem et stort skip, og til styrmann fikk de Ridder Rød.
illustrations.alt: Tolv prinser vinker fra et stort skip som seiler ut fra land. Bakerst står Ridder Rød ved roret og kneiser.

illustrations.anchor: Han gikk fram og tilbake på dekket.
illustrations.prompt: A pale pink dawn after the storm, on the deck of the Ship on a calm sea. The eleven older princes lie fast asleep in a heap among coils of rope, and Ridder Rød snores slumped over the tiller, his helmet tipped over his eyes. Only the Youngest Prince is awake: he leans on the rail, looking at a small rocky island gliding past, where the little dog stands on a rock, barking at him.
illustrations.caption: På en liten øy sto en liten hund og bjeffet. Voff! Voff! Voff!
illustrations.alt: Brødrene og Ridder Rød sover på dekket. Bare den yngste kongssønnen er våken og ser på en liten øy der en liten hund står og bjeffer.

illustrations.anchor: Midt på gulvet begynte det å glitre og gnistre rundt den lille hunden.
illustrations.prompt: In the Pillar Hall, lit by warm lamps between the tall columns, glitter and sparkles swirl in the middle of the floor where the little dog stood a moment ago. Out of the shimmer rises the Troll Prince's Daughter, her pale hair and thin veil floating around her, the last sparkles still twinkling at her bare feet. A few steps away the Youngest Prince stands frozen, eyes wide and mouth open. Medium-wide view.
illustrations.caption: Og så var hunden borte! I stedet sto det en prinsesse der.
illustrations.alt: Midt i en sal med høye søyler glitrer og gnistrer det. Der hunden sto, står nå en prinsesse med langt, lyst hår og et tynt slør. Kongssønnen står helt stille og stirrer.

illustrations.anchor: Han tok en tredje slurk.
illustrations.prompt: In the Pillar Hall, the Youngest Prince twirls the old sword high over his head as easily as a wooden spoon, grinning with surprise, the blade gleaming in the lamplight. The Troll Prince sits on his long bench against the wall, holding the round blue bottle and nodding kindly, his big webbed feet crossed in front of him. The Troll Prince's Daughter stands by a column, clapping her hands.
illustrations.caption: Nå svingte han sverdet like lett som en tresleiv. Svisj! Svisj!
illustrations.alt: Kongssønnen svinger et gammelt sverd over hodet like lett som en sleiv. Den store trollprinsen sitter på benken med en flaske og nikker, og datteren hans klapper.

illustrations.anchor: Foran slottet sto vaktene.
illustrations.prompt: Blue dusk before the gate of the troll king's castle, a dark stone castle on a rocky shore with golden light in its windows. Two grey wolves, two big brown bears and three lions all lie down at the Youngest Prince's feet like tame dogs. The biggest lion has rolled onto its back, purring like a cat, while the Youngest Prince, the old sword tucked under one arm, scratches its shaggy mane with a surprised grin.
illustrations.caption: Den største løven begynte til og med å male som en katt.
illustrations.alt: Ulver, bjørner og løver ligger ved føttene til kongssønnen utenfor et stort slott i skumringen. Den største løven ligger på ryggen og maler som en katt.

illustrations.anchor: Da skjønte prinsessene at han var kommet for å hjelpe dem.
illustrations.prompt: A great hall full of gold, with golden walls, heaps of gold and a tall golden throne, on which the Troll King sits fast asleep, all twelve of his heads snoring with their mouths open. The twelve little golden chairs around him are emptying as the princesses tiptoe away one by one in a quiet line towards the Youngest Prince, who waits by a pillar with the old sword, a finger to his lips. The Youngest Princess leads the line and her eleven sisters follow; none of them wear crowns.
illustrations.caption: Stille, stille listet prinsessene seg bort på tærne, én etter én.
illustrations.alt: Et rustrødt troll med tolv små hoder sover og snorker på en gulltrone. Tolv prinsesser lister seg bort på tærne mot kongssønnen, som står ved en søyle med fingeren mot munnen.

illustrations.anchor: Men de ble med i land likevel.
illustrations.prompt: The great golden hall in bright daylight, with the tall golden throne standing empty. The eleven older princes in their grey-blue coats crowd in the doorway, gaping with their mouths wide open. In front of the empty throne, twelve happy princesses laugh and wave: the Youngest Princess and her eleven sisters, without crowns. The Youngest Prince stands beside them with his arms folded and a proud little smile, the old sword at his belt.
illustrations.caption: Der sto den tomme tronen og tolv glade prinsesser. Brødrene ble stående og gape.
illustrations.alt: Elleve prinser står i døren og gaper. Foran den tomme gulltronen står tolv glade prinsesser, og den yngste kongssønnen smiler fornøyd.

illustrations.anchor: Imens fant kongssønnen skapet med gullkronene.
illustrations.prompt: Late afternoon on the grey-green sea just off a rocky shore. The Youngest Prince sits in a small rowing boat that rides low in the water under the heavy crown cupboard squeezed in beside him. He has stopped rowing and shades his eyes with one hand, looking this way and that. All around, the sea is empty to the horizon: no ship, not a single sail. Wide, lonely view.
illustrations.caption: Han så hit, og han så dit. Ikke et seil. Bare hav.
illustrations.alt: Kongssønnen sitter i en liten båt med et stort, tungt skap og skygger for øynene. Utover havet er det ikke et eneste seil å se.

illustrations.anchor: Kongssønnen trillet fire tønner rug ut fra stabburet.
illustrations.prompt: Sunrise in front of the big, quiet stone castle on the rocky shore. The Giant Bird towers over everything, taller than the castle gate, happily gobbling rye out of three big wooden barrels standing in a row, grains flying. The Youngest Prince, tiny beside its huge orange feet, rolls the fourth barrel over from a little storehouse on stilts, leaning his head far back to look up at the bird and its huge copper-red neck feather.
illustrations.caption: Fire hele tønner rug! Fugl Dam spiste opp alt sammen. Nam, nam, nam.
illustrations.alt: Foran et stort slott står en kjempestor fugl og spiser rug av tre tønner, og kongssønnen triller den fjerde tønnen fram. Han må legge hodet bakover for å se opp på fuglen.

illustrations.anchor: Snart fløy de over skipet.
illustrations.prompt: High in the bright sky over the jade-green sea, the Giant Bird flies with its huge wings spread wide. The Youngest Prince rides on its back, holding on tight to the copper-red neck feather. The crown cupboard hangs tied with ropes on one side of the bird's neck, and a big bulging sack of gold and silver on the other side. Far, far below, the Ship sails along with tiny figures on its deck. Wide view from above and behind.
illustrations.caption: Langt der nede seilte Ridder Rød og alle de andre.
illustrations.alt: Kongssønnen flyr på ryggen til Fugl Dam, med skapet på den ene siden av halsen og en sekk med gull og sølv på den andre. Langt der nede seiler skipet.

illustrations.anchor: Langt om lenge kom de fram til trollprinsen.
illustrations.prompt: In the Pillar Hall, the Troll Prince jumps for joy with both big webbed feet high off the floor and his arms flung wide. The whole hall shakes: the hanging lamps swing and dust drifts down from the ceiling. The Youngest Prince laughs and holds on to a column. Through a tall arched window, the Giant Bird peers in with one big, kind eye.
illustrations.caption: Trollprinsen ble så glad at han hoppet, og hele slottet ristet.
illustrations.alt: Den store trollprinsen hopper av glede så hele salen rister og lampene svinger. Kongssønnen ler og holder seg i en søyle, og Fugl Dam kikker inn gjennom vinduet.

illustrations.anchor: En natt seilte skipet forbi, og kongssønnen listet seg om bord.
illustrations.prompt: Night in a small wooden cabin on the ship, lit by moonlight through a round porthole. The Youngest Princess sleeps alone in a narrow bunk bed, with a big, shiny sword lying beside her on the blanket. On the floor in front of the bed, Ridder Rød lies on his back snoring, his helmet tipped over his face. In the doorway the Youngest Prince tiptoes past with a small lantern and the old sword under his arm, one finger to his lips.
illustrations.caption: Den yngste prinsessen sov med det blanke sverdet ved siden av seg.
illustrations.alt: I en liten lugar sover den yngste prinsessen med et blankt sverd ved siden av seg. Ridder Rød snorker på gulvet, og kongssønnen lister seg forbi i døren.

illustrations.anchor: Snart så han skipet.
illustrations.prompt: Out on the rough, windy sea, the Youngest Prince stands in the small dark iron boat as it races along by itself, carefully lifting the heavy iron club in both hands. Close beside him, the Ship heels over in a sudden gust, its sail bulging and white spray flying, and the tiny figures on its deck run about hauling on ropes, far too busy to look his way. Grey-green waves and racing clouds.
illustrations.caption: Han løftet klubben igjen. Huuuu! Det blåste og skvulpet.
illustrations.alt: Kongssønnen suser forbi i en liten jernbåt og løfter en jernklubbe. Ved siden av krenger det store skipet i vinden, og alle om bord løper og drar i tau.

illustrations.anchor: Den gamle konen var den mest nysgjerrige konen i hele landet.
illustrations.prompt: Inside a tiny, cluttered hut with one small window. The Sailor sits squeezed onto a stool in the corner, his two bulging sacks at his feet, holding his head with both hands as if it aches. The Nosy Old Woman leans in so close that her nose almost touches his, one finger raised, firing questions at him while peering sideways at the sacks through her thick spectacles. Close view, cosy and funny.
illustrations.caption: Hun hadde knapt lukket døren før hun begynte å spørre.
illustrations.alt: I en liten hytte lener en nysgjerrig gammel kone seg helt inntil sjømannen og spør og spør. Sjømannen sitter i et hjørne med sekkene sine og holder seg for hodet.

illustrations.anchor: Mer trengte hun ikke.
illustrations.prompt: Outside the tiny hut on a bright, windy day. Up the path comes a line of five other old women of different shapes and sizes, in shawls and headscarves, hurrying one after another, and the first one knocks hard on the door. The Nosy Old Woman flings the door open with a delighted grin, and the Sailor peeks out of the little window beside it, looking amused.
illustrations.caption: Snart kom venninnene hennes, én etter én. Bank, bank, bank!
illustrations.alt: Fem gamle koner står i kø utenfor den lille hytten og banker på. Den nysgjerrige konen åpner døren, og sjømannen kikker ut av vinduet.

illustrations.anchor: Elleve prinsesser lo og sang.
illustrations.prompt: A sunny beach below the royal farm, with the Ship pulled up at the water's edge and flags flying, and the eleven older princes cheering at its rail. The King, in his finest gold-embroidered cloak, laughs with joy while eleven princesses without crowns dance and sing in a ring around him. A little apart, the Youngest Princess stands crying and wiping her tears, and Ridder Rød stands close beside her with his chest puffed out and a smug smile.
illustrations.caption: Elleve prinsesser lo og sang. Men den yngste prinsessen gråt.
illustrations.alt: På stranden danser elleve prinsesser rundt kongen. Den yngste prinsessen står litt borte og gråter, og ved siden av henne står Ridder Rød og kneiser.

illustrations.anchor: Der lå tolv gullkroner, tett i tett.
illustrations.prompt: In the Great Hall, the Sailor, who now goes about as a peddler, has set the crown cupboard down on the floor and opened its two doors. Inside, twelve small golden crowns sit close together, shining so brightly that golden light fills the whole hall. The King leans forward from his tall chair in amazement, the Youngest Princess and her eleven sisters gasp with their hands to their mouths, and Ridder Rød stares, suddenly nervous.
illustrations.caption: Der lå tolv gullkroner, tett i tett. De skinte så det lyste i hele salen.
illustrations.alt: Kremmeren har åpnet skapet sitt i storsalen. Der ligger tolv gullkroner som skinner så hele salen lyser. Kongen, prinsessene og Ridder Rød stirrer.

illustrations.anchor: Da kastet kremmeren av seg matroskoften og det røde tørkleet.
illustrations.prompt: In the Great Hall, a big dark-blue knitted sailor's jacket and a red kerchief fly through the air, and there stands the Youngest Prince in his forest-green jacket, finer than anyone, smiling. The Youngest Princess beams at him with her hands clasped. The King gapes from his tall chair. Ridder Rød stands stiff as a stick, his face turning tomato red. All twelve princesses now wear their golden crowns, and the eleven sisters cheer in the background.
illustrations.caption: Og der sto den yngste kongssønnen, finere enn alle de andre.
illustrations.alt: Kremmeren kaster av seg den store koften og det røde tørkleet, og der står den yngste kongssønnen. Prinsessen stråler, kongen gaper, og Ridder Rød blir rød i ansiktet.

illustrations.anchor: Nå ble det glede på kongsgården!
illustrations.prompt: A warm spring evening in the yard of the royal farm, strung with lanterns and flower garlands between the log buildings. Twelve bridal couples dance in a big ring to the music of three fiddlers: in the middle, the Youngest Prince and the Youngest Princess whirl hand in hand, and around them the eleven older princes dance with the eleven older princesses, all the princesses wearing their golden crowns. The King claps along, beaming.
illustrations.caption: Det ble tolv bryllup på én gang, med musikk og dans som hørtes i tolv kongeriker.
illustrations.alt: Tolv brudepar danser på tunet på kongsgården. I midten danser den yngste kongssønnen og den yngste prinsessen, og kongen klapper i takt.
